python -c "
import parse

# Test R7: %f variable-length fractional seconds
print('Testing R7 (%f variable-length)...')

regex = parse.dt_format_to_regex('%H:%M:%S.%f')
print('  Pattern:', regex.pattern)

# Test with different lengths of fractional seconds
for ts in ['14:30:45.1', '14:30:45.12', '14:30:45.123', '14:30:45.123456']:
    match = regex.match(ts)
    if match:
        print(f'  {ts} -> groups: {match.groups()}')
    else:
        print(f'  {ts} -> NO MATCH')
"
